reference.name: Ni/ZrO2 on FeCrAl, electrified RWGS (Topsoe eREACT)

uncertain.why: grey ~2 USD/kg; electrolytic 5-7 USD/kg (DOE Liftoff 2024, S)
capacity basis of the 76 M USD not stated: x0.5-2
US gas to electric heating at 0.08 USD/kWh

sources.thermo: K_rwgs(T) from data/meoh/meoh_general_model.py (methanol loop model), ideal gas; dH 41.2 kJ/mol for the heat duty
sources.plant: Topsoe eREACT whitepaper: 900 C, 10 barg, H2:CO2 = 2.25, CH4 slip < 0.2 % above 900 C (https://www.topsoe.com/hubfs/DOWNLOADS/DOWNLOADS%20-%20White%20papers/19549%20Electrical%20Reverse%20Shift%20Whitepaper_FINAL.pdf)
sources.reference.X: assumption 0.60 per pass (equilibrium about 0.66 at 900 C, 11 bar, H2/CO2 2.25 in this model)
sources.reference.elements: Ni on ZrO2-coated FeCrAl (eREACT whitepaper); 10 wt % assumption
sources.species.H2.price_usd_t: 3 USD/kg, the anchor of the methanation model (Becker, Penev & Braun 2019)
sources.species.CO2.price_usd_t: 100 USD/t as in the methanation model (Enterprise Products EPA application: 104 USD/t captured)
sources.capex.usd: RWGS reaction area installed equipment 76 M USD (Zang, Sun, Elgowainy, Wang, Environ. Sci. Technol. 2021, doi 10.1021/acs.est.0c08674, OSTI 1807681 l.361-366); plant capacity basis not stated -> range x0.5-2
sources.energy: assumptions: fired heater 85 %, 2 GJ/t CO2 preheat/separation, power 60 + 40 x recycle kWh/t
sources.catalyst: life 3 y (Zang l.255: catalysts replaced every three years); base 20 USD/kg assumption
sources.check: no open per-tonne CO cost with a breakdown was found; the check is the stoichiometric floor (H2 + CO2) and the share of capital
